story.title: Reasoning Gym · knights_knaves
story.text: A very special island is inhabited only by altruists and egoists. Altruists always tell the truth, and egoists always lie. You meet 2 inhabitants: Mason, and Jack. Mason expressed that if Jack is an egoist then Mason is an altruist. In Jack's words: "Mason is an egoist". So who is an altruist and who is an egoist? (Format your answer like: "Mason is a altruist/egoist, and Jack is a altruist/egoist")

options: Mason is an egoist, Jack is an altruist
Mason is an egoist, Jack is an egoist
Mason is an altruist, Jack is an egoist
Mason is an altruist, Jack is an altruist

zh.story_text: A very special island is 有一座小岛，岛上只有利他者和利己者。利他者总说真话，利己者总说假话。 你遇到了 2 个居民：Mason, and Jack. Mason expressed that if Jack is an egoist then Mason is an altruist. In Jack's words: "Mason 是egoist". So who is an altruist and who is an egoist？ (Format your answer like: "Mason 是altruist/利己者, 并且 Jack 是altruist/利己者")
options: Mason 是利己者，Jack 是利他者
Mason 是利己者，Jack 是利己者
Mason 是利他者，Jack 是利己者
Mason 是利他者，Jack 是利他者
